CANDIDATES (fixed now, chosen to include coins that later collapsed or were delisted, to limit survivorship): BTC ETH BNB XRP ADA SOL DOGE DOT LTC LINK BCH TRX AVAX MATIC POL ATOM ETC XLM EOS FIL UNI NEAR AAVE ALGO VET ICP SHIB APT ARB OP SUI LUNA FTT WAVES XMR NEO IOTA ZEC DASH XTZ SAND MANA AXS FTM APE GALA CHZ CRV INJ TON PEPE WIF HBAR THETA EGLD (all vs USDT; perp symbol for SHIB/PEPE = 1000SHIB/1000PEPE, price-scaled; a symbol absent on data.binance.vision is skipped and logged). UNIVERSE U_m: on the first day of each month, the 25 candidates with the highest USDT quote volume over the previous 30 days among those with >=180 days of prior data and a bar on the last day of the previous month; a coin whose data stop mid-month is closed at its last close. TIMING: weights for day t+1 use data through the 23:00 bar close of day t only; P&L_(t+1) = sum w_i*r_i,(t+1) - cost*sum|w_i,(t+1)-w_i,t(drifted)| - funding. FUNDING: a perp position of weight w pays w*f for each funding print f in the day (long pays positive f); before a symbol has funding history, assume f = 0.0001 per 8h. COST per side per unit notional traded: perp 5 bp taker + 2 bp spread/slippage = 7 bp; spot leg 7.5 bp + 2 bp = 9.5 bp. COST x2 = double all. VOL: sigma_i = 60-day rolling std of daily r, x sqrt(365). PERIODS: in-sample IS = 2019-01-01..2022-12-31 (used only for D3-09 hour selection and for the fixed scale factor below; reported); OUT-OF-SAMPLE OOS = 2023-01-01..2026-09-30 (never used to choose any rule). GATE (decisive, OOS, cost x1, per variant): net daily mean > 0 with t >= 3.5504 where t = min(iid t, Newey-West lag-10 t) AND bootstrap p5 of the mean > 0 where p5 = min(10k iid, 10k circular block length 20; seed 0) AND look-ahead/truncation test passes (positions on every day up to a random cut date are identical when all data after the cut are deleted; 50 cuts per variant). REPORTED: annualized Sharpe (sqrt 365), CAGR, max drawdown, worst day, per-year table, turnover, cost x2 result, IS result. CAGR/maxDD also shown after scaling each variant's net series by the factor that gives 20% annual vol in IS (fixed from IS, so ex-ante for OOS; D3-09 uses 1x). result_mean_R = OOS net mean bp of capital per day; result_p5_R = decisive p5 in bp/day.
